name: Bobcat Summer STEM Academy (High School Academies)
what_you_do: Take a hands-on STEM workshop at UC Merced. UC Merced scientists made the workshops, and its students and staff lead them. 2026 high school topics were microbes, physics labs, drones, coding dark matter in Python, and math with coding.
who_can_apply: In 2026: students entering 9th grade in fall 2026 through students graduating 12th grade in spring 2026. Students moving from 8th to 9th grade can join the high school academies.
pay_detail: 2026 fees: $160 for a week, $100 for 3 days, $70 for 2 days, $40 for 1 day. Some 2026 academies were free thanks to grants. There were no regular scholarships in 2026.
duration: 1 day to 1 week workshops, Monday to Friday, 8:30 am to 3:30 pm
deadline_text: 2026 academies ran June 8 to July 24, 2026 (not the first week of July). 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Register and pay online through the link on the Bobcat Summer STEM Academy page. If the workshop you want is full, join the waitlist. Each high school workshop had 24 seats in 2026.
notes: Lunch, snacks, supplies and a T-shirt are included. For questions, contact Mariah Gonsalez, who runs K12 outreach for CalTeach. Her email is on the page.
